verdict.rationale: VPM lets operators choose per-item whether mail is opened/scanned or shipped unopened (docs-9, docs-19), and offers automation rules for handling mail (docs-2/17), giving some per-item disposal control. However there is no documented storage window policy, no shredding option, and no confirmation workflow for destruction anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: documented storage duration/retention window, explicit shredding option, and destruction confirmation records.
